news.title: Clarity Act’s failure gave crypto ‘faster’ regulatory wins, Bitwise CIO says

news.title: CFTC secures over $30 million judgment against defendants in Fundsz fraud case

news.title: Dogecoin Is Getting Apps as DogeOS Opens Its Public Testnet
news.summary: The team behind the MyDoge wallet opened a public test of DogeOS, a layer that lets developers build lending platforms and games on top of the meme coin network.

news.title: FBI Tells Its Employees to Assume Hackers Have Their Personal Data
news.summary: An internal memo warned FBI staff that ShinyHunters, the group claiming it hacked the bureau's jobs site, may hold their private details.

news.title: Coinbase-Backed Crypto Group Reveals Midterm Endorsements After Clarity Act Collapse
news.summary: The Coinbase-backed group's first Senate endorsements—Republicans Jon Husted and Ashley Hinson and Democrat Chris Pappas—come two weeks after the Clarity Act's collapse, as the industry's fight shifts to the campaign trail.

news.title: Standard Chartered sees Ethena’s USDe reaching $40B, ENA hitting $2
